g.title: seq
g.text: 12a Personnel spending: from an authorized position to the monthly payroll and the remittances

a.text: 1. GMIS to Personnel unit: Approved staffing
pattern: positions, classification, salary
grades
2. Personnel unit to GMIS: Monthly update of
the plantilla of personnel in GMIS (PSIPOP):
filled and vacant positions
3. Head of agency to GMIS: Approval of the
update in GMIS (second approver)
4. GMIS: Personnel budget of the next year
computed from the FILLED positions in GMIS
5. Head of agency to Employees: Appointment to
a vacant, funded position
6. Personnel unit to CSC: Appointment papers
for attestation
7. CSC to Personnel unit: Attested appointment
8. Personnel unit to Budget unit: Payroll,
prepared in advance: gross pay, deductions and
net pay of each employee. An authorized
official certifies: services duly rendered
(Box A)
9. Budget unit: Budget unit: obligation
request. Head of accounting certifies:
documents complete, cash available (Box B).
Journal entry: salary expense, and the amounts
due to BIR, to the insurance bodies and to the
employees
10. Budget unit to Head of agency: Payroll for
approval
11. Head of agency to Budget unit: Approved
for payment (Box C)
12. Accounting unit to Servicing banks:
Payment order for the net pay: to the accounts
of the employees, or as an advance to the
disbursing officer who pays in cash
13. Servicing banks to Employees: Net pay. For
cash: each employee signs the payroll, and the
disbursing officer certifies that each one was
paid (Box D)
14. Employees to Personnel unit: Reports of
attendance, after the payroll. An overpayment
for an absence without pay is demanded back
15. Budget unit to GSIS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG:
Tax withheld (by Tax Remittance Advice),
premiums and contributions of employee and
government

a.xlink:title: skip: Shortage in one personnel benefit

a.text: 16. Head of agency to Budget unit: Advice for
use of PS Allotment (APSA)

a.xlink:title: end of: Shortage in one personnel benefit
